name: Kanzaki Azuma
source:
Akizuki High School, 3rd year student. Captain of the Superpower club.
A hotblooded youthful idiot, enjoying the springtime of youth is the most important thing in his life.
He has the superpower "Super Vibration" which he can use to control the vibration of molecules.
